ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel distribution across the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are restricted to small, isolated regions, representing <5% of the total ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of a uniform dark pigment field. Small, high-intensity punctate clusters are visible in the lower-central region near the notch and as sparse, non-contiguous mottling on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow, acute V-shaped central depression with a deep vertical bounding-box penetration; estimated interior pixel angle of 35-45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetric serration profile. The left lobe trailing edge displays moderate undulation, while the right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-amplitude, irregular negative deviations (notches) creating a jagged linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex curvature of the trailing edge from the median notch to the tips, with significant non-linear interruptions on the right lobe due to edge trauma.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, high-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, corresponding to calcareous barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notches and missing tissue segments along the trailing edge of the right lobe; dense barnacle encrustations at both distal fluke tips.
